name: MPI-537 Phase 4 - Input_*/Output_* title law on the lipdub graph
summary: MPI-537 closed. Phase 4 applied the Input_*/Output_* title law to the lipdub graph (6 titles; MpiLoadVideo and MpiSaveVideo each replaced a PAIR of core nodes; three bypassed Gemma-API nodes dropped; the two mandatory loader substitutions baked in), proven equivalent by a re-run of the refvoice_tiny settings and a /history diff showing 24 shared nodes byte-identical. Judged working by Fabio. Also established that the SHIPPED i2v graph already does audio-driven lipsync from a supplied track, under three conditions now documented in docs/models/ltx/audio-input.md.
